FAQs
01. Are DSU’s online degrees valid for government jobs?
Yes. All DSU online degree courses are UGC entitled and carry the same weight as a regular degree, making them fully valid for government examinations and employment.
02. What support does DSU provide for career development?

While DSU doesn’t offer job placements directly, it provides career development support through workshops, industry webinars, alumni sessions, and resume review tools to prepare students for job readiness.
03. Can I pursue an MCA or B.Com from DSU online while working?
Absolutely. DSU’s online bachelor degree and MCA programs are structured for working professionals and students who prefer a flexible schedule.
04. How are online classes conducted at DSU?
Classes include live lectures, recorded videos, assignments, quizzes, and discussion forums. This allows students to learn at their own pace while staying connected with mentors.
05. Is peer-to-peer learning encouraged?
Yes. DSU hosts virtual study groups, discussion boards, and collaborative project opportunities to keep students engaged and connected.
